jobs.description:

UKIMEA Region

NEW00027U Requisition \#  

Graduate Civil Engineer \- Energy


See it differently \- Early Careers at Arup


See it differently


You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently ,it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.


Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.


The Opportunity


Our Civil Engineering team works at the heart of the energy transition, helping to deliver the infrastructure needed to connect renewable energy and improve the resilience of electricity networks. We support major projects across hydrogen and sustainable fuels, offshore wind, transmission and distribution, energy storage, nuclear, HVDC infrastructure and pumped storage hydro. As a graduate engineer, you will work alongside experienced specialists and gain hands\-on experience in the planning, design and delivery of civil infrastructure, including site development, earthworks, drainage, highways and access arrangements. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, use industry\-leading digital tools and contribute to projects that have a lasting impact on the UK's net\-zero ambitions.


Contribute to the planning, design and delivery of major energy infrastructure projects, including hydrogen and sustainable fuels, offshore wind, transmission networks, substations, HVDC schemes, nuclear and energy storage developments.


Support the development of civil engineering designs for earthworks, drainage, highways, access roads, foundations and site infrastructure using industry\-leading digital tools.


Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of engineers, environmental specialists, planners and project managers to develop integrated engineering solutions.


Undertake technical assessments, engineering calculations, site investigations and preparation of reports, drawings and project deliverables.


Develop professional and technical skills through structured training, mentoring and hands\-on project experience while supporting the delivery of sustainable infrastructure that enables the energy transition.


https://www.arup.com/services/civil\-engineering/


https://www.arup.com/markets/energy/energy\-storage/


https://www.arup.com/markets/energy/transmission\-distribution/


https://www.arup.com/markets/energy/hydrogen\-and\-sustainable\-fuels/


Is this role right for you?


For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes: Masters level in relevant academic discipline, such as Civil Engineering, Construction Management; Ground / Geotechnical Engineering; Structural Engineering.


Skills and experience in Civil Engineering Design Principles; Engineering Drawing Interpretation; AutoCAD; Drainage and Surface Water Design; Earthworks and Highway Design; Technical Report Writing; Data Analysis and Visualisation; Problem Solving and Engineering Calculations. Civil 3D; GIS (ArcGIS/QGIS); Microsoft Excel; BIM Awareness (ISO 19650\); Revit (basic understanding);


To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:


Full working rights in the country of application


No more than 12 months of full\-time experience in a comparable role


Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.


Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes:


Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key.


Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo.


Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working.


Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way.


What we offer you


At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.


Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.


We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.


We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.


We also provide for our permanent members Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

  

Next Steps


We've designed our application process to be straightforward and supportive, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills and potential. Applications are reviewed as they're received, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.


The process includes an online application, psychometric testing, application review, case study, interview and offer stage. Our friendly Early Careers team is available throughout the process to answer questions and help you feel confident every step of the way.

  

Different people, shared values


Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas \- this drives our excellence.


Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas.

Please contact UKEarlyCareersRecruitment@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

LON0005CT Requisition \#  

**Joining Arup**


Arup is an independent firm, owned in trust by our employees. Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. This may be as a direct output of the project or where we can influence our client’s direction in a beneficial way.
  

  

Arup’s Science, Industry, Healthcare and Data Centre Team is a global network of Architects, Engineers and Specialist Consultants working with the largest and most innovative businesses across each sector. Our clients include developers; retail and wholesale colocation providers and the major hyperscale cloud services providers, pharmaceutical companies, universities and research institutions.
  

  

Our London team delivers SIT projects globally including HV substation design, placing innovation, sustainability, decarbonisation and excellence at the heart of our designs. Arup’s electrical engineers bring specialist expertise to solutions for buildings, transport infrastructure and energy, water and waste utilities. Our comprehensive services include energy audits, demand assessment, supply and system resilience, utilities consultancy and sustainable electrical engineering design.


At Arup, you will belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
  

We are offering an exciting opportunity for a Chartered Principal Electrical Engineer. If you thrive on technically stimulating work and have a passion for cutting\-edge projects, we invite you to join our creative and friendly SIT team in London as a permanent member.


Watch this short clip to discover how Arup are shaping a better world and how you could be a part of it!

  

**The Opportunity**


This is an opportunity for a talented and enthusiastic Chartered / Incorporated Principal Electrical Engineer.
  

Our team is looking to strengthen its project level leadership through the recruitment of an electrical engineering lead who can provide a combination of technical, project and business area leadership. They will hold specific multi\-disciplinary technical leadership and management responsibilities within the Property business.


Our projects need to be part of the transition to net\-zero carbon and increasingly we see electrical engineering sitting at the heart of how that transition can be achieved. We are looking for a candidate who currently acts as an electrical discipline lead who is looking to continue to deliver projects whilst developing into a technical specialist or leadership position.


You will be a key part of a multidisciplinary, collaborative team of Engineers and Technicians, working flexibly from our London office. Our projects are global and will allow you to work with and succeed in an international, multi\-cultural business environment with a strong focus on sustainability in all we do.
  

  

**Responsibilities will include:**


* As a Principal Electrical Engineer you will be responsible for the production of the electrical and MEP designs on your projects and as such will be accountable both to project leaders and the electrical discipline within the business, taking responsibility for projects from inception to completion to achieve outstanding results.
* This will include:
* Working under minimal supervision, you’ll understand when you need the support of those you work with to complete tasks and assignments
* Leading the design development of electrical systems or sub\-systems from concept design through construction whilst coordinating with other engineering disciplines and specialists. This will include the preparation of drawings, reports, specifications and calculations.
* Coordinating the design analysis and working with the team to optimise systems
* Support the organisation and leadership of technical resources to deliver project objectives
* Support the development of the design programme
* Representing the Electrical discipline at internal and external meetings
* Developing others and supporting their development through guidance, training and feedback, with the opportunities to act as Line Manager.
* In this role you will have the opportunity to act as Project Manager, responsible for the resourcing, commercial delivery and success of the project.

**Is this role right for you?**
  

**We’re looking for a candidate who can demonstrate:**


* Has an inquisitive nature and desire to investigate and research new opportunities, ways of working and technologies that enhance our engineering offering
* Is an enthusiastic Principal Engineer with the ability to form and nurture relationships with clients through good communication and influencing skills
* The ability to delegate tasks to more junior members of the team
* To act as a mentor to younger engineers spreading knowledge and support them as required
* To act as an IET Mentor assisting younger engineers to obtain chartership

**Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector.


Core benefits include cover under the UK Healthcare Plan (private medical insurance), Life Assurance, Accident Insurance, and Income Protection (long term disability) cover.


Core benefits are funded by us and made available to all permanent staff in order to support and safeguard your financial, physical, and mental wellbeing. You will also have access to Choice Benefits to help with your work/life balance and financial security.


In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance.


**Different People, Shared Values**


At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
  

  

At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks \- BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ\+ and Women \- provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference.


At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.


At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.


Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup.
  

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates.


Please contact Aslam Hussein at Aslam.Hussain@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment\-process/

jobs.description:
**Base Location:** Perth, Aberdeen, Glasgow, Inverness, Reading, Thatcham, New Forest, Poole. You’ll be expected to spend 50% of your working week at one of these locations.


**Salary**: £71,869 \- £85,880 \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern**: 16 Month Fixed Term Contract \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



The Technology Standards team is our source of engineering policy, standardised equipment and configurations for the substation control systems on our distribution network – including protection, automation and telecontrol systems. This role gives an opportunity to shape the control systems of the future, and to tackle engineering challenges associated with critical Operational Technology solutions.



As an Asset Technology Standards Engineer, you'll help shape the future of SSEN's substation control systems, developing the standards, specifications and secure\-by\-design solutions that support a smarter, more resilient electricity network. Working across technologies such as Remote Terminal Units (RTUs), protection systems and programmable logic controllers, you'll lead equipment selection, testing and configuration, driving standardisation and innovation while supporting the delivery of a digitised network that enables Net Zero.


**You will**


* Develop and maintain technical standards, specifications and engineering policies for substation control systems, ensuring compliance, consistency and safe operation across the network.
* Design, test and approve operational technology solutions, including RTUs and substation control equipment, creating standardised configurations and repeatable designs for business\-wide deployment.
* Lead technical assurance activities by developing test plans, evaluating equipment against specifications and supporting equipment approval and procurement decisions.
* Apply cyber security and NIS regulatory requirements to both existing and new operational technology systems, helping protect critical electricity infrastructure.
* Provide technical leadership and subject matter expertise to projects, working groups and stakeholders, influencing strategy, innovation and continuous improvement across the business.


**You have**


* Extensive experience designing, configuring and/or commissioning substation control systems, telecontrol equipment and automation solutions within electricity networks.
* Strong knowledge of Operational Technology, including RTUs, telecommunications protocols and substation automation, with expertise in DNP3 and ideally IEC61850\.
* Hands\-on experience configuring industry\-standard control system equipment, preferably Schneider Talus, Hitachi/ABB RTU520\-560, ZIV XCell or SEL Axion/RTAC platforms.
* Experience producing engineering schematics and technical drawings using AutoCAD, alongside developing robust technical documentation and standards.
* A strong understanding of cyber security principles, substation protection and control schemes, and the operation of electricity distribution networks.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Distribution, part of the wider SSE group, powers 3\.9 million UK homes and businesses. Our team of more than 4,200 skilled engineers, customer service advisors and energy experts keep customers connected to a safe, reliable supply of electricity while investing in and developing the flexible networks needed for our low carbon future.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact laura.morrison@sse.com / 01738 341814 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.
